title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (South Dakota)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due November 1 for general property. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

title: Notify residents and regulators of a data breach within 60 days (South Dakota)
description: If personal information of residents of the state is acquired without authorization, notify affected residents within 60 days of discovering the breach and the Attorney General if more than 250 residents are affected (S.D. Codified Laws 22-40-20). This is an event-driven duty, so it has no calendar date. Sources in the PR describe the state's rule in different words; check the statute for the exact trigger and content of the notice.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.
